sampling: Sort by scene and image. Independently use NumPy default_rng(20261026) per dataset, without replacement. E1b, E1d and E2b share this roster; E1c uses its LM-O and IC-BIN entries.

statistics.cross_pair: same target, different masks, one correct and one wrong

E1.E1b: The same refined winners from 33-17. FP and MegaPose each in singleton and same-target joint calls; C2, renderer-mask IoU, negative truncated observation-to-CAD distance.
E1.E1d: Reuse E1b FP singleton scores; no registration. Compare with archived 252-in-call raw and same-target joint.
E1.E1e: Archived B1 base and B3 expanded pools on original 33-17 IPD and XYZ-IBD, all their valid calls.
E1.AR_selection: Descending by row score; 33-17 tie key, translation NMS at 0.3D and first n_t.

chamfer.observation: All valid positive depths inside the source mask
chamfer.CAD: 8192 area-weighted surface samples from the same mesh as registration, NumPy seed 0 per object

E1.set_sensitivity: Absolute singleton-versus-joint score differences, divided by pooled within-call score IQR in the same scope. If IQR is zero and all differences are zero, report zero. If IQR is zero with a nonzero difference, report undefined.

E2.GT_scope: Offline counts only, through the frozen 33-17 Y7 visible-instance count ratio, for grid, dataset choices and R8 predictions. No pose result, AP or output composition is used. Inference reads detections only.

E2a.selection: Keep 0.2. For each target in order, take the nearest remaining grid value by absolute median difference, breaking ties by lower threshold. If the target falls outside the achieved range, take the available endpoint. Record coincident achieved ratio levels, unattainable targets and any non-nested retained pools.
E2a.reuse: Register each distinct mask hash once, including all S/G seen at any chosen threshold. Rebuild augmentation and jointly score independently at every chosen threshold.

E2b.selection: Rank the five dataset medians (tie by dataset code), take first and last. Preregister predictions before pose work.

E3.criterion: Reject S/G candidates with C2 below the selected threshold after registration and before count. Reuse the B4 stored scores, perform NMS/recount on survivors.
E3.calibration: On XYZ-IBD C at official NOCTIS threshold, among 0.00–1.00 in 0.05 steps choose the largest C2 threshold retaining at least 70% of B4–B1 AP gain, with a nonpositive original gain deemed uncalibratable. Apply the frozen threshold unchanged to IPD.

R1.degrade: CI intersects [0.50,0.80) and does not reverse
R1.comparable: CI low >= 0.80 and within-call minus cross-call < 0.10

reading.R2: Every scorer classified independent in E1a is comparable or degraded in E1b. Interpret only if a second architecturally set-dependent scorer is identified.
reading.R3: Spearman across scorers between normalized sensitivity P90 and strict cross-call accuracy <= -0.6; descriptive if fewer than six scorers.
reading.R5: Both IPD and XYZ-IBD B1 raw FP cross-call CI highs < 0.50. Report expanded B3 too.
reading.R6: Each E2a dataset: Spearman across the four levels between median count ratio and B4 minus B1 <= -0.8.
reading.R7: IPD has a level with count ratio < 1 and CI low of B4 minus B1 > 0; XYZ-IBD has a level with count ratio > 1.5 and CI high < 0. Both required.
reading.R8: Below 1 predict B4 minus B1 >= 0; above 1.5 predict <= 0; between or at endpoints give no prediction. Both chosen datasets must have a prediction and CI must not contradict it.
reading.R9: IPD rejection minus B1 CI low > -1 AP point and at least 70% of the XYZ-IBD C gain retained.
